jobs.description:
For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Destelbergen.Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit? 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry located in Zottegem, is looking for a motivated and experienced Technical Operator.Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?As a Technical Operator, you play a crucial role in the production process.You ensure that the production lines run efficiently and intervene quickly whenever deviations occur. Thanks to your technical insight, accuracy, and problem-solving skills, production continues smoothly.Your responsibilities: 
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring production lines. 
• Performing quality checks and making adjustments where necessary. 
• Detecting technical malfunctions and independently resolving minor defects. 
• Carrying out machine changeovers, cleaning your equipment, and ensuring machines function correctly. 
• Recording production data and strictly following established procedures. 
• Assisting with preventive maintenance and actively contributing ideas for process improvements. 
• Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment at all times.Working hours are from Sunday evening to Friday morning in a fixed night shift from 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM.
 
• You have previous experience as a Technical Operator. 
• You have a strong technical interest and are eager to learn. 
• You are willing to work in a fixed night shift. 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English. 
• You work accurately, responsibly, and have a strong focus on quality. 
• You can independently analyze and solve technical issues. 
• You are a team player and communicate effectively with colleagues. 
• You perform well under pressure in a fast-paced production environment. 
• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy taking initiative. 
• You have your own transportation or can easily commute to the workplace during night hours. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant - International and Dynamic Environment
jobs.description:
Company Presentation

We are recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing company operating in the service sector linked to healthcare, located in the Brussels region.

This human-sized structure operates in a dynamic and modern environment, where innovation and service quality play a central role. The team, made up of around ten employees, works in a professional yet friendly atmosphere, with an accessible management style focused on collaboration.

The company stands out for its financial stability, continuous growth, and a corporate culture built on trust, autonomy, and teamwork. Internal initiatives and strong cohesion between departments contribute to a pleasant and motivating working environment.

Missions / Responsibilities

• Oversee the full accounting scope, both general and analytical, across multiple entities, ensuring accuracy and compliance of financial data.
• Record and follow up on day-to-day transactions (purchase and sales invoices, financial operations, and various accounting entries).
• Prepare and submit VAT returns, ensuring full compliance with Belgian tax regulations.
• Actively participate in monthly and annual closings, including period-end entries and cut-off operations.
• Perform bank reconciliations and ensure proper monitoring of customer and supplier balances.
• Carry out account reconciliations and ensure consistency of accounting records.
• Contribute to financial reporting and the preparation of dashboards for management.
• Participate in the continuous improvement and optimisation of accounting processes and internal tools.
• Collaborate with internal teams and, when necessary, with external partners (accounting firms, auditors, etc.).

Profile Required

• Education Degree in accounting, finance, or equivalent through experience.
• Experience Minimum 5 years of experience in general accounting, ideally in a multi-entity or international environment.
• Technical skills Strong command of accounting tools and Excel. Good knowledge of accounting closings and Belgian tax obligations. ERP knowledge is an asset.
• Languages Fluent in French and strong professional level of English, both written and spoken.
• Personal qualities Rigorous, autonomous, analytical mindset, and strong team spirit. You are also proactive and solution-oriented.

The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Bringing together various services, activities and partners on one site, the company relies on strong internal coordination to ensure smooth day-to-day functioning. To support this mission, it is looking for an Office Manager who will play a key role in the operational and administrative management of the location.

Jobomschrijving

The Office Manager acts as a central point of coordination for the Technical Director and supports various operational teams across the shopping centre.Administrative Management She/he manages internal and external communications, prepares and reviews documents, maintains updated tenant information, circulates weekly footfall data to the Landlord, the Property Manager and the internal team, and organises meetings and conferences. She/he also manages agendas, appointments and administrative workflows.Coordination She/he collaborates closely with internal departments, external partners and tenants to ensure fluid communication and the smooth running of ongoing projects. Responsibilities include drafting meeting minutes, monitoring deadlines, managing office supplies, and overseeing the Info Desk schedule, orders and administrative tasks, including basic support with SUMUP-related matters.Reception & Customer Relations As a representative of the shopping centre, she/he welcomes visitors, partners and clients in a warm and professional manner and provides clear, accurate information regarding the centre's services and activities.Information Management She/he maintains all records, files and databases, ensures confidentiality and data security, oversees the publication and updates of House Rules on Chainels and manages internal communication such as "What's Up" on Chainels.Support to Management She/he assists the Facility Manager with follow-up on files such as security and insurance, prepares ad hoc reports and summaries to support decision-making and provides occasional support to the marketing team when needed.

The ideal candidate demonstrates professionalism, discretion and strong organisational abilities.Key criteria include:

• A flexible and hands-on approach.
• A degree in Business Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field.
• Previous experience in an Executive Assistant, Office Manager or similar role; experience in a shopping-centre environment is a strong asset.
• Excellent organisational, prioritisation and time-management skills.
• Strong proficiency in MS Office and digital tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, anticipate needs and take initiative.
• High level of discretion and a proactive mindset.
• Fluency in French, Dutch and English.

jobs.occupation: Team Leader Design Office - Dilbeek - Fast Growing Company
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established Belgian engineering group with offices located in the Dilbeek area, offering a modern and easily accessible work environment. You will join a structured technical department within a stable and growing industrial organisation.

• Coach and develop a team of 10 technical specialists
• Organise and oversee the daily planning of the technical office
• Provide technical advice to clients, project managers and internal teams
• Prepare and validate cost calculations and technical quotations
• Analyse technical drawings, specifications and client requirements
• Manage client communication regarding ongoing orders and changes
• Drive process improvements and automation initiatives

• Master's degree in civil engineering, architecture or a technical field
• Minimum 8 years of proven experience in a technical office environment
• Native Dutch speaker with good command of English and French

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Our client is a leading industrial manufacturing company investing in the expansion and modernization of one of its production sites.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate engineering activities from concept and feasibility studies through execution.
• Act as the interface between engineering, production, and project management teams.
• Support the delivery of multidisciplinary installations, including civil works, mechanical equipment, utilities, and electrical systems.
• Monitor project planning, technical coordination, and execution to ensure objectives are met.
• Contribute to the successful implementation of brownfield CAPEX projects within an operational production environment.

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, or a multidisciplinary engineering background with a strong civil engineering foundation.

• Excellent coordination and communication skills, with the ability to work across multiple stakeholders.

Our client based in Nivelles is an international and fast-growing company operating in the logistics and supply chain sector. Renowned for its collaborative culture, innovation-driven mindset, and commitment to talent development, the company offers an excellent environment for young professionals looking to launch their career in Supply Chain.To strengthen their operations team, they are currently looking for a motivated Junior Supply Chain Graduate eager to learn, grow, and gain exposure to end-to-end supply chain activities.

Jobomschrijving

As a Junior Supply Chain Graduate, you will support various supply chain functions and gain valuable hands-on experience across planning, logistics, inventory management, and operations.Your responsibilities will include:

• Supporting demand planning and forecasting activities
• Monitoring inventory levels and helping optimize stock availability
• Coordinating with suppliers, warehouses, and transportation partners
• Tracking deliveries and ensuring smooth order fulfillment
• Assisting with data analysis and preparing supply chain performance reports
• Identifying operational improvement opportunities and supporting continuous improvement initiatives
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders such as Procurement, Customer Service, Logistics, and Operations
• Participating in supply chain projects related to process optimization, digitalization, and performance enhancement
• Ensuring accurate data management within ERP and supply chain systems
• Contributing to the achievement of service, quality, and cost objectives

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Engineering, Economics, Operations Management, or a related field
• Recent graduate or first professional experience within Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, or Planning
• Strong analytical mindset with good problem-solving abilities
• Fluent in English; French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
• Comfortable working with data and supply chain KPIs
• Eager to learn and develop within an international environment
• Organized, proactive, and detail-oriented
• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with different stakeholders
• Team player with a positive and hands-on attitude

Are you ready for a new challenge where your expertise can truly make a difference?
 

If you have a Scientific degree and experience in Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field, this is your opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself. As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.
 

Every day, your work will directly contribute to delivering life-changing therapies to patients facing serious diseases. Join a passionate team united by a shared purpose: creating innovative treatments and improving lives around the world.
 

Your key responsibilities:
 

 
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
 
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained at least a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute daily to improving the lives of patients with life-threatening diseases? As a Lab Technician you will work with a passionate team to develop groundbreaking therapies and make a real difference for patients worldwide.
 

Your key responsibilities:
 

 
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
 
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.

• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell culture experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

jobs.description:
Do you speak Polish, German, and English?Do you enjoy helping people and gain energy from phone-based customer contact and administrative tasks? In this Customer Service Representative role, you will support customers who need assistance when their vehicle breaks down. You ensure clear communication and provide fast, effective solutions.

A gross salary starting from €2,500 per month, supplemented with:

Our client helps drivers and transport companies get their vehicles back on the road quickly in the event of a breakdown or mechanical issue. You will work in a small team where communication is direct and straightforward. The organization operates internationally, and you will interact daily with a wide variety of people and profiles. The company is located in Hasselt.

.

Warehouse Operator | Flexible Schedule
Are you looking for a side job or a part-time position?
 Can you work from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM on a weekly basis? Available every other week or every third week? That's possible too!

For our client TVH in Waregem (located near the E17 motorway), we are looking for warehouse employees who would like to work on a flexible schedule.

We are looking for people to sort and unpack incoming parts and goods.

Your responsibilities will include:
 

 
• Sorting delivered goods. 
 
• Physically removing parts and goods from their packaging. 
 
• Checking quantities and stock counts. 
 
• Taking the initiative to keep the workplace clean and tidy. 
 
• Following all safety rules and procedures. 

 
• You can work from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM. Available every other week or every third week? That's possible too! 
 
• You work accurately and are disciplined in following instructions. 
 
• You have a good command of Dutch or English. 
 
• Physical work is not a problem for you (lifting and carrying items).

At Agristo, you are the key player in the packaging process: from frozen fries to a perfectly packaged and palletized product. With your technical affinity and problem-solving abilities, you manage our packaging lines, coordinate the planning, and ensure a flawless process. Are you looking for a challenging role with responsibility, teamwork, and growth opportunities in a dynamic work environment? Join us and grow with a strong, ambitious family business!What will you be doing at Agristo? 
• Process Management: You are responsible for the entire packaging process, from frozen fries to a fully palletized and packaged product. 
• Operation and Adjustment: You provide first-line support for any issues on the line, make adjustments when necessary, and continuously expand your technical knowledge of our processes. 
• Planning & Coordination: You monitor and adjust the packaging schedule, coordinating its execution with the team leader to meet the planned goals. 
• Cleanliness and Hygiene: You ensure a clean and organized work environment by overseeing and coordinating cleaning tasks. 
• Material Management: You are responsible for the timely ordering and availability of necessary materials, such as film, cardboard, and spices. 
• Problem Solving: You proactively identify issues in the packaging process and take corrective actions to ensure continuity. 
• Administrative Support: You perform administrative tasks, such as reporting incidents and documenting process information. 
• Packaging Testing: You assist in and conduct packaging process tests in collaboration with Agristo colleagues. 
• Knowledge Sharing: You contribute to the development of instructions and training materials and support knowledge transfer within the team. 
• Employee Guidance: You mentor and support team members, helping them enhance their skills and knowledge.With this diverse range of responsibilities, you are an essential link in ensuring a smooth and high-quality packaging process!
 
• You have solid experience as a packaging operator in the food industry or have already gained experience in a coordinating role. 
• You possess technical and process insight. 
• You have a problem-solving mindset, are not afraid to critically assess existing processes, and take initiative to implement improvements. 
• You speak Dutch, French, or English and are willing to communicate with colleagues who speak different languages.

Are you a driven team player with a passion for agriculture and technology? As operator potato inbound you are at the base of our production, with challenging tasks in quality, technique and logistics. Will you become our new colleague?What will you be doing at Agristo? 
• You will be responsible for the entry control of the quality of the delivered potatoes and for the corresponding administration & registration. 
• You supervise the proper operation of the installation and signal deviations if necessary. 
• You are responsible for cleaning the line and checking various parameters. You can solve first-line disturbances in a professional way, for more complex technical issues you can count on our production technicians. 
• Then you take care of a perfect treatment, namely washing, sorting and stocking of the potatoes. 
• You are also responsible for loading all by-products.
 
• You are socially fluent and keen on quality, safety, order & cleanliness, discipline and punctuality. 
• You are willing to work 2 shifts. 
• You are fluent in a number of current software programs. 
• You are able to drive a forklift truck and terminal truck or are willing to learn to do so. 
• The variety and physical aspect of the job appeals to you. 
• You speak and write Dutch or English fluently.

As a logistics operator, you are responsible for monitoring and managing logistics processes, resolving malfunctions, performing technical interventions, and working with modern systems in an automated cold storage environment. You work in a two-shift system and have a technical affinity.What will you be doing at Agristo?As a logistics operator, you are responsible for: 
• Monitoring and managing the processes within the logistics department to ensure continuity. 
• Identifying and resolving irregularities and malfunctions in the logistics flows. 
• Carrying out minor technical interventions to ensure a safe and smooth flow of goods. 
• Working with modern systems and operating cranes and shuttles in the automated cold storage facility. 
• Interpreting data trends and reporting process information with the aim of contributing to improvement actions for the logistics department.
 
• You have a technical affinity. 
• You hold a valid forklift and reach truck certificate, or you are willing to obtain one. 
• Working in a colder environment doesn’t scare you, and you are not afraid of heights. 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system (5 a.m. – 1 p.m. and 1 p.m. – 9 p.m.). 
• You are comfortable working with computers and eager to learn new programs. 
• You work efficiently and with respect for safety and quality standards. 
• You have a good command of Dutch, French, or English.

Do you enjoy physical work and don't mind working in a cold environment? Are you comfortable working in the meat industry (pork)? Then this opportunity could be perfect for you!

For our client’s deboning department, we are looking for a motivated employee with experience as a butcher, meat deboner, or within the meat processing industry.Your Profile

• Experience as a butcher, deboner, or within the meat industry is a strong asset.
• You are motivated and enjoy hands-on work.
• You preferably speak and understand at least two of the following languages: Dutch, English, or Polish.
• If you speak one of these languages well, you are also welcome to apply.
• You work accurately and have an eye for quality.

Your Responsibilities

• Deboning and processing pork products.
• Working according to quality, hygiene, and safety standards.
• Cooperating with colleagues in a production environment.
• Keeping your workplace clean, organized, and safe.

Are you someone who enjoys working with precision and finds satisfaction in quality control? As a quality control associate, you’ll ensure that goods are properly inspected, counted, and recorded. You’ll maintain an overview, quickly identify discrepancies, and make sure everything is correct down to the smallest detail. You’ll work a fixed late shift from 2:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m.

• A quick start in a stable logistics environment
• Work hours on the late shift from 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM

Our client operates in the logistics sector in Puurs. You’ll be working in an international environment where quality and the proper handling of goods are paramount. Colleagues support one another and work according to clear guidelines and procedures. This ensures that you always know what’s expected of you.

.

Our client is a growing logistics company in the textile industry. The company has positioned itself internationally as an important player in the sector and continues to develop rapidly. With a strong focus on customer orientation, they provide solutions in the logistics chain. Due to their rapid growth, they are looking for enthusiastic and driven employees who can contribute to their further expansion.

Jobomschrijving

As a Back-up Team Leader, you are the right hand of the team leader. You take over responsibilities during their absence and assist in managing a warehouse team on a daily basis. Together, you ensure smooth operations, high quality, and a positive working atmosphere.

Your responsibilities:

• Support and replace the team leader in daily operations
• Coordinate and motivate team members on the shop floor
• Monitor productivity, quality, and safety
• Report progress and issues to management
• Contribute ideas for process improvements

Do you recognize yourself in the items listed below:

• experience in logistics or warehouse operations
• leadership skills with a hands-on mentality
• Communicates in both Dutch and English
• flexible
• Works well under pressure and is solution-oriented

Your responsibilities as a Senior Treasury Analyst :

• Manage liquidity, cash flow planning and day-to-day treasury operations across multiple entities.
• Oversee international banking relationships, cross-border payments and multi-currency activities.
• Develop and improve treasury processes, policies and internal controls.
• Work with Treasury Management Systems.
• Support treasury transformation through automation, system improvements and process standardisation.
• Analyse and optimise treasury data.
• Collaborate with Finance and other stakeholders across an international organisation.

About the candidate :

• You have experience improving treasury processes, policies and control frameworks.

• You are a strong team player who communicates effectively across different functions and stakeholders.
• You are comfortable working in a fast-changing and sometimes ambiguous environment.
• You speak fluent English; no other languages are required.

As an Operations Manager at Skechers, you report directly to the Director of Operations and independently manage several departments. 

Your key responsibilities include:
  
• Planning, organizing, and supervising daily operations to meet short- and long-term goals, while ensuring budget, deadlines, and safety standards are met in an automated environment. 
• Promoting and maintaining a strong safety culture. 
• Developing strategic business plans for the short, medium, and long term for your departments. 
• Taking necessary actions to achieve performance objectives by defining and monitoring team KPIs, while effectively managing operational costs. 
• Leading, coaching, evaluating, and developing your teams (approx. 150 people) in collaboration with Team Leaders and Leads. Communication is central to your role—both with your teams and social partners. 
• Managing and optimizing automated processes with a continuous improvement mindset.  
This role requires adaptability, versatility, and a proactive approach to overcoming daily challenges and driving operational excellence.

Education and technical skills: 
 
• Minimum 3 years of proven experience in a similar role within an automated/production environment. 
• Proficiency in WMS, WCS, and AS400 systems. 
• Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook). 
• Strong working knowledge of English.  
Your personality and soft skills:
  
• Leadership – You are a driver of change and adapt easily to a constantly evolving environment. 
• Communication – You adjust your communication to suit your audience and actively listen. 
• Customer & results orientation – You go the extra mile to ensure customer satisfaction. 
• Stress management – You remain positive and composed when facing day-to-day challenges. 
• Conflict resolution & negotiation – You are assertive and diplomatic when managing tensions. 
• Attention to detail – You are uncompromising when it comes to safety and adherence to procedures and workplace rules.

jobs.occupation: IT Support Technician – L1 Resident Engineer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk. 

User support
  
• Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site 
• Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals 
• Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support 
• Resolve basic connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN) 
• Support meeting rooms and videoconferencing equipment (Teams, cameras, microphones, screens)  
Access and security
  
• Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures 
• Apply IT security policies and immediately report any suspicious incident (phishing, malware, unauthorised access)  
Hardware and lifecycle
  
• Install, configure and prepare IT equipment (PCs, iOS/Android mobile devices, peripherals) 
• Handle IT onboarding and offboarding of employees (workstation preparation, handover and collection of equipment, access rights) 
• Keep the IT inventory up to date and coordinate replacements, warranties, repairs and disposals 
• Tickets, escalation and coordination 
• Log, prioritise, track and close tickets in the ITSM tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management…) 
• Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs 
• Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers 
• Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions 
• Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)  
You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.
 
THE TEAM & THE MANAGER
 
Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential 
 
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT 
• At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support 
• Fluent French and English, both spoken and written 
• Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA 
• Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity  
Assets
  
• Knowledge of Arabic 
• Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer 
• Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment 
• IT certifications (CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)  
Soft skills
  
• Customer focus and service mindset 
• Autonomy and rigour in incident management 
• Clear communication with non-technical users 
• Hands-on, proactive attitude
